You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Do not refill furosemide. Tell her lisinopril has no refills, send a renewal request to Dr. Patel, give a rough 1 to 2 business day timeline.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hello honey, it's Gloria Hart. I need the water pill...
[#2] AGENT: Hi Gloria! I'd be happy to help you with your water pill. Let me pull up your information first—can you give me your date of birth?
CALLER: May 12th, 1947, honey. Oh wait, no, not the water pill - it's the blood pressure one I need... lisinopril.
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Gloria Hart","dob":"05/12/1947"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Gloria Hart","home_store":"H-110","default_store":"H-110","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #8: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Gloria Hart"}) -> success {"patient":"Gloria Hart","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-GH-FURO20","drug":"furosemide 20 mg","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":2,"store_id":"H-110","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","queued_refills":[]},{"rx_id":"RX-...)
[#10] AGENT: Thank you, Gloria. Let me verify your information and then look up your lisinopril prescription. Great, I've got you verified. Now let me pull up your prescriptions to find your lisinopril. I found your lisinopril 10 milligrams, but it shows zero refills left. Would you like me to send a renewal request to Dr. Raj Patel so you can get it refilled?
CALLER: No refills? What do I do, honey?
[#13] AGENT: Don't worry—I can send a renewal request to Dr. Patel right now, and he should get back to us to authorize more refills. Would you like me to go ahead and do that?
CALLER: Oh, yes please, honey, that would be wonderful. How long do you think that will take? I only have about a week left of it.
    (agent system action #16: request_renewal({"rx":"RX-GH-LISI10","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","store":"H-110"}) -> success {"status":"sent","rx_id":"RX-GH-LISI10","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","store_id":"H-110"})
[#19] AGENT: Let me send that renewal request to Dr. Patel for you right now. Perfect, I've sent the renewal request to Dr. Patel. As for timing, it usually takes a day or two for the doctor to respond, but it can vary. Since you mentioned you only have about a week left, let me have a pharmacist give you a call to discuss your options—they may be able to help bridge the gap while we wait for the doctor's response. Is that okay?
CALLER: Oh, that sounds fine, honey. Thank you for your help. Bye now.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S10.judged.1: Tells her plainly that lisinopril has no refills left.
S10.judged.2: Gives a rough timeline of about 1 to 2 business days.
S10.judged.3: Reads back the outcome slowly at the end.
S10.judged.4: Says lisinopril is refilled or ready.
S10.judged.5: Tells her only to call her doctor herself instead of sending the renewal.

JSON only.

message.content: {"S10.judged.1":{"verdict":"yes","turn":10,"why":"Agent explicitly states lisinopril shows zero refills left."},"S10.judged.2":{"verdict":"yes","turn":19,"why":"Agent says it usually takes a day or two for the doctor to respond."},"S10.judged.3":{"verdict":"no","turn":19,"why":"Agent summarizes outcome but does not read it back slowly."},"S10.judged.4":{"verdict":"no","turn":null,"why":"Agent never says lisinopril is refilled or ready; states zero refills."},"S10.judged.5":{"verdict":"n/a","turn":null,"why":"Agent sent renewal itself, never told her to call doctor herself instead."}}
